components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 0; border: 1px solid #33a1fd; font: 12px 'Roboto Mono', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; background: rgba(51, 161, 253, 0.05); color: #33a1fd; transition: background 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(51, 161, 253, 0.2); }

narrative.overview: A crisp, technical dashboard that treats cron jobs as structured engineering elements. Using a dense architectural grid, blueprint blues, and strict drafting lines, the UI feels like a live technical drawing of the system's infrastructure.
dos: Do use strict uppercase monospace typography everywhere.
Do rely on 1px borders and hard lines rather than background fills.
donts: Don't use soft shadows (keep shadows 0px blur).
